$comment: Mirrors app.api.intel_schemas.NoteRecordRequest. Catch-all prose intel that doesn't fit a structured row; still FTS-indexed and engagement-scoped.
title: Intel Note Record

title.description: Short descriptive title — unique per engagement.

lead_status.description: Set to make this note a tracked *lead* (an actionable hypothesis/thread): open|in_progress are the worklist; resolved|ruled_out are closed. Omit/null for a plain reference note. Lead titles must be unique per engagement (title is the natural key) or a re-record overwrites the prior disposition.

superseded_by_id.description: Backend id of the intel row that superseded this one. Set automatically by `vigil assess supersede-intel`; report-writer filters on this so stale rows do not appear in reports.
